source.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1 meter Digital Elevation Model, bare earth, from lidar
source.licence: Public domain (U.S. Government work; "All 3DEP products are public domain")
source.citation: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program 1-Meter Resolution Digital Elevation Model, accessed 2026-10-11 at https://www.usgs.gov/the-national-map-data-delivery

method: For each building centroid and asset, the median of the 1 m DEM cells whose centre lies within 2 m of the point (11 to 14 cells); accepted only when at least 50 % of those cells hold data, otherwise no data (-32768 in buildings.bin, null in assets.json). The DEMs are bare earth (buildings and vegetation removed, ground under buildings interpolated by the producer, water bodies hydro-flattened), so the value is the ground at the building, not its roof or floor. The newest collection with a value wins (2024, then 2018); within a collection the tile with the most valid cells. Points are WGS 84 longitude/latitude projected to NAD83 / UTM 19N or 20N on GRS 80 without a datum shift (about 1 m). Values are metres above PRVD02; buildings.bin stores them rounded to decimetres as int16, assets.json in metres with two decimals. Nothing is filled or interpolated across gaps.

datum.vertical: Puerto Rico Vertical Datum of 2002 (PRVD02), EPSG:6641
datum.how_confirmed: USGS WESM.csv (the 3DEP work-unit register) gives vert_crs for every work unit behind these tiles; the vendor DEM metadata gives altdatum/altunits. The GeoTIFFs themselves carry no vertical CRS and no unit tag, and their sidecar XML only carries the national boilerplate quoted below, which names NAVD88 (a datum that does not exist in Puerto Rico).
vendor_altdatum: Puerto Rico Vertical Datum of 2002, Geoid 12B
Virgin Islands Vertical Datum of 2009, Geoid 12B
datum.caveat: One work unit of the newest collection is registered with vert_crs 6642 (Virgin Islands Vertical Datum of 2009); the register does not say which tiles it produced. It is expected to be the U.S. Virgin Islands part of the project, where Garita has no buildings.
